builds.summary: An original no-respec solo route that brings the published level-20 Shamanistic Focus milestone forward, secures Stormstrike at level 25, and takes Improved Ghost Wolf before finishing the early Improved Stormstrike pickup. It is a BM Gaming Wiki synthesis, not a copied source build.

milestones.note: Take Stormstrike at the first level the guide identifies as available.
Begin the Improved Stormstrike mana and reset investment; later ranks are outside this route's coverage.

builds.respecDisclosure: This route does not respec. Icy Veins also describes an optional Restoration-first route and respec at 25, but its written guide does not publish that route's complete rank allocation; it is not offered here as an automatic build.
